appTagline.message: Turn any web novel into a book worth keeping.
appTagline.description: A one-line description of the extension.

workbenchTitle.description: The title of the main page.

workbenchStoryDetails.description: The heading of the metadata panel.

workbenchCover.description: The heading of the cover section.

workbenchOptions.description: The heading of the options section.

workbenchChapters.description: The heading of the chapter list.

workbenchChapterCount.description: How many chapters are visible, out of how many were found.

workbenchPack.description: The button that builds the book.

workbenchSave.description: The button that saves the metadata.

workbenchCancel.description: The button that stops a download.

workbenchRetry.description: The button that starts a failed or cancelled download again.

workbenchDismiss.description: The button that hides a finished download's status.

workbenchSavedAs.description: Shown when the book has been saved, with its file name and size.

workbenchSelectAll.description: The button that selects every chapter.

workbenchSelectNone.description: The button that deselects every chapter.

workbenchInvert.description: The button that inverts the selection.

workbenchRanges.description: The button that picks a range of chapters.

workbenchRangeTitle.description: The heading of the range dialog.

workbenchRangeFrom.description: The first chapter of the range.

workbenchRangeTo.description: The last chapter of the range.

workbenchRangeCount.description: How many chapters the range covers.

workbenchRangeCountOne.description: How many chapters the range covers, when there is one.

workbenchRangeSelect.description: Selects the chapters in the range.

workbenchRangeDeselect.description: Deselects the chapters in the range.

workbenchRangeInvalid.message: Enter a chapter number between 1 and $COUNT$.
workbenchRangeInvalid.description: Shown when the range cannot be used.

workbenchFilter.description: The button that opens the filter.

workbenchBusy.description: Why Pack is unavailable while a download runs.

workbenchWaitingForChapters.description: Shown while the chapter list loads.

workbenchDetected.description: Shown when a parser recognised the site.

workbenchFieldFilename.description: The name the EPUB is saved under.

workbenchChooseFromPage.description: Picks the cover image from the page.

workbenchIncludeAuthorNotes.description: Keeps the notes at the end of a chapter.

workbenchIncludeTocPage.description: Adds the table of contents as a chapter.

workbenchOptionsHint.message: These apply to every book you make.
workbenchOptionsHint.description: Explains that the workbench's switches change the settings.

workbenchNoCover.description: Shown when there is no cover image.

workbenchCoverUrl.description: The address of the cover image.

workbenchNoStoryHere.message: No story found on this page
workbenchNoStoryHere.description: Shown when the page is not a story.

workbenchNoStoryHint.message: Check that this is the story's chapter list, or show Kintsugi where the chapters are.
workbenchNoStoryHint.description: Shown under the empty chapter list.

workbenchUnsupportedSite.message: This site is not supported yet

workbenchFieldUrl.description: The field holding the address of the story's page.

workbenchFieldUrlHint.message: Paste the address of the story's chapter list.
workbenchFieldUrlHint.description: The hint under the story address field.

workbenchLoadStory.description: The button that loads the story at the given address.

workbenchUrlInvalid.message: That is not a web address.
workbenchUrlInvalid.description: Shown when the address in the story field cannot be used.

accessTitle.description: The heading of the site access prompt.

accessText.message: Kintsugi can only read a site you have allowed. The pages are read on your machine, and nothing is sent anywhere.
accessText.description: The explanation under the site access prompt.

accessGrant.description: The button that asks the browser for access.

accessDenied.message: Access was not allowed, so the story cannot be read.
accessDenied.description: Shown when the user declines the browser's permission prompt.

accessGranted.message: Kintsugi can now read this site.
accessGranted.description: Shown when the user has just allowed the site.

chapterStateQueued.description: A chapter that is waiting to be fetched.

chapterStateFetching.description: A chapter that is being fetched.

chapterStateLoaded.description: A chapter that has been read.

chapterStateDownloaded.description: A chapter that is in the book.

chapterStateFailed.description: A chapter that could not be read.

chapterStateNotStarted.description: A chapter that has not been fetched yet.

phasePreparing.description: The first stage of a download.

phaseFetchingChapters.description: The stage that reads the chapters.

phaseDownloadingImages.description: The stage that reads the images.

phaseBuildingEpub.description: The stage that assembles the book.

phaseSaving.description: The stage that writes the file.

phaseComplete.description: Shown when the book is saved.

phaseCancelled.description: Shown when the download was stopped.

popupLibraryShort.description: The popup's library button's visible label.

popupWorkbenchShort.description: The popup's workbench button's visible label.

popupNoStory.message: No story detected on this page.
popupNoStory.description: Shown when the page is not a story.

popupWelcome.message: Welcome to Kintsugi. Let’s set things up before your first book.
popupWelcome.description: Shown on the first run, before the onboarding.

popupGetStarted.description: The popup's button that opens the onboarding.

popupUnsupported.message: This site is not supported yet.

popupChecking.description: Shown while the popup waits for the worker.

popupUnsupportedHost.description: Shown when no parser matched the current site.

popupChapterCount.description: How many chapters the popup found.

popupChapterCountOne.description: How many chapters the popup found, when there is one.

optionsSiteAccess.description: The list of sites the extension may read.

optionsSiteAccessEmpty.message: No sites yet. Kintsugi asks when you open a story.
optionsSiteAccessEmpty.description: The empty state of the site access list.

optionsSiteAccessHint.message: Kintsugi can only read the sites listed here.
optionsSiteAccessHint.description: The hint under the site access heading.

optionsRevoked.message: The site's access was taken back.
optionsRevoked.description: Shown after a site's access is revoked.

optionsRevokedAll.message: Access to every site was taken back.
optionsRevokedAll.description: Shown after access to every site is revoked.

optionsExportSettings.description: Saves the settings to a file.

optionsImportSettings.description: Loads the settings from a file.

optionsResetAll.description: Restores every setting to its default.

optionsExported.message: The settings were saved to a file.
optionsExported.description: Said after the settings are exported.

optionsImported.message: The settings were loaded from the file.
optionsImported.description: Said after the settings are imported.

optionsImportInvalid.message: That file is not a Kintsugi settings file.
optionsImportInvalid.description: Said when the imported file cannot be read.

optionsResetDone.message: Every setting is back to its default.
optionsResetDone.description: Said after the settings are reset.

optionsResetConfirm.message: Every setting goes back to its default. Your library and your saved sites are not touched.

optionsPrivacyNote.message: Kintsugi sends nothing to anyone. Every network request goes to the site you are reading.
optionsPrivacyNote.description: The note at the foot of the settings.

optionsLibrary.description: The library tab, and the books you have built.

optionsLibraryEmptyText.message: Books you build are kept here, so you can update them when a new chapter is posted.

optionsNoResults.description: Shown when a settings search finds nothing.

optionsNavLabel.description: The accessible name of the settings navigation.

optionsLibraryMetaOne.description: The library card's metadata line, when the book has one chapter.

optionsLibraryImport.description: The button that imports a library exported by WebToEpub 1.x.

optionsLibraryImported.description: Confirmation after importing a library, when it held several books.

optionsLibraryImportedOne.description: Confirmation after importing a library, when it held one book.

optionsLibraryTooLarge.message: That file is too large to import. The largest library Kintsugi can read is $SIZE$.
optionsLibraryTooLarge.description: Shown when the user picks a library export that is larger than Kintsugi will read.

libraryRemove.description: Removes a book from the library.

settingReduceMotionHint.message: Turns off transitions even when the system does not ask for it.

settingFilenameTemplateHint.message: {title} and {author} are replaced when the file is saved.

settingDefaultLanguageHint.message: The ISO 639 code used when a site does not declare one.

settingRemoveAuthorNotesHint.message: Strips the notes many authors put at the end of a chapter.

settingRemoveChapterNumbersHint.message: Removes the number a site puts at the start of a chapter's title.

settingIncludeTocPage.message: Include the table of contents as a chapter

settingEpubVersionHint.message: Version 3 is the standard. Version 2 is for older readers.

settingAddInfoPageHint.message: A page with the title, author, and source.

settingIncludeSourceUrl.message: Include the source URL in each chapter

settingSkipFailedChaptersHint.message: A failed chapter becomes a note in the book instead of stopping the run.

settingEmptyPageIsError.message: An empty page is an error

settingEmptyPageIsErrorHint.message: Some sites answer a blocked request with a blank page. When this is on, that page is reported as a failure instead of becoming an empty chapter.

settingMinimumDelayHint.message: In milliseconds. Raise it for sites that rate-limit aggressively.

settingDelayPerChapterHint.message: In milliseconds, on top of the minimum delay.

settingDiagnosticsHint.message: Logs more detail to the console. Off by default.

onboardingNext.description: The button that moves to the next step.

onboardingBack.description: The button that moves to the previous step.

onboardingFinish.description: The button that completes the onboarding.

onboardingSkip.description: The button that skips the onboarding.

onboardingGetStarted.description: The button that leaves the onboarding.

onboardingWelcomeText.message: Turn any web novel into a book worth keeping. Point it at a chapter list, and it builds a clean EPUB — cover, table of contents, and all.

onboardingWelcomeFootnote.message: No account. No tracking. Works offline.

onboardingWhichSiteText.message: Kintsugi knows hundreds of sites. Open one, and it offers to build the book.

onboardingWhichSiteFootnote.message: Not listed? Kintsugi can still read it — you can build a selector yourself.

onboardingMakeItYoursText.message: This is a live preview. Pick what you like.

errorGeneric.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errorNoParser.message: Kintsugi does not know this site yet.

errorTimeout.message: The site took too long to answer.

errorParse.message: The page could not be read.
errorParse.description: The page could not be parsed.

errorNoChapters.message: No chapters were found on this page.

filterUseRegex.description: Whether the search is a regex.

filterMatchCount.description: How many chapters match the filter.

optionsNumberRequired.description: Shown under a number setting that was left empty.

filterNoMatches.description: Shown when the filter hides every chapter.

filterClearAll.description: Removes the filter so every chapter shows again.

filterInvalidPattern.message: That is not a valid pattern.
filterInvalidPattern.description: Shown when the regex does not compile.

siteSelectorBannerTitle.description: The title of the banner shown when the fallback parser is used.

siteSelectorBannerText.message: Kintsugi is guessing where the story is. Tell it once and it will remember.

siteSelectorOpen.description: The button that opens the site selector dialog.

siteSelectorIntro.message: These CSS selectors tell Kintsugi where a chapter's text is. They are remembered for this site alone.

siteSelectorContent.description: The label of the content selector field.

siteSelectorContentHint.message: The element that holds the chapter's text, as a CSS selector.

siteSelectorTitle.description: The label of the title selector field.

siteSelectorTitleHint.message: The element that holds the chapter's title. Optional.

siteSelectorRemove.description: The label of the remove selector field.

siteSelectorRemoveHint.message: Comments, ads and navigation to strip out. Optional.

siteSelectorSuggest.description: The button that asks the scanner for a suggestion.

siteSelectorSuggested.message: Guessed from the page. Test it before you save.
siteSelectorSuggested.description: Shown after the scanner has proposed selectors.

siteSelectorTest.description: The button that tests the selectors against the page.

siteSelectorTestResult.description: How much text the content selector matched.

siteSelectorTestFailed.message: That selector did not match anything on this page.
siteSelectorTestFailed.description: Shown when the test finds nothing.

siteSelectorInvalid.message: That is not a valid CSS selector.
siteSelectorInvalid.description: Shown when a selector does not parse.

siteSelectorSaved.message: Saved. Kintsugi will use these for this site from now on.

siteSelectorList.description: The options page's site selector section.

siteSelectorListEmpty.message: No site has been set up yet.
siteSelectorListEmpty.description: The empty state of the site selector list.

siteSelectorTocDetected.message: That page looks like a table of contents, not a chapter. Open a chapter and try again.
siteSelectorTocDetected.description: Shown when the scanner recognises a table of contents.

commonClose.description: The label of a button that closes a dialog.

commonDismiss.description: The label of a button that dismisses a notification.

commonCancel.description: The label of a button that cancels an action.
